title: Same speed, one spark. Which rocket launches first? 🚀
description:
One spark lights a hub. Five tangled fuses run from it to five rockets, and every fuse is a smooth random curve whose length is within 12% of the others. The flame burns at the same constant speed on every fuse, the whole way, and the speed never changes. Wherever two fuses cross there is a marked junction: the flame jumps across in both directions and then burns both ways along the fuse it lands on. The first flame to reach its rocket launches it, and the rest follow in arrival order. The numbers over the rockets are the fuse left in front of each flame, in seconds at burn speed, so every shortcut shows up as a sudden drop.
The burn is an exact shortest-path calculation over the fuse layout; the close finish comes from searching seeds for one, not from editing the race. Layout, motion and sound are generated by code (seed 34), with no footage, samples or stock media.
Which rocket did you pick?
#simulation #satisfying #fireworks
pinned_comment: Pick your rocket before the flame reaches the first junction: orange, cyan, magenta, gold or green? Same burn speed on every fuse, so only the layout and the jumps decide it. Comment your color, then check the finish.
synthetic_media_disclosure_reason: Clearly stylised 2D animation of abstract lines and shapes; nothing realistic that could be mistaken for real people, places or events.
